documentation: audience/README.md is the shared rule sheet for the newsletter editor and the Library. These proposed labels are not approved assignments. Set status to reviewed only after the Reviewer checks the original notice. Then run node audience/apply.mjs. Do not guess labels from keywords.

map.reason: This stage does not add audience filters to the map. Do not describe newsletter, Library and map filters as one complete set.

assignments.library_title: ECO Kutno: drilling of geothermal wells Kutno GT-1 and GT-2

excluded.label: Equipment
excluded.reason: Casing and other materials are inside the drilling package. An integrated drilling package does not automatically get an Equipment tag.

excluded.label: Engineering & Services
excluded.reason: Hydrogeological tests are described with the drilling package. Routine tests inside that package do not automatically get an Engineering & Services tag.

assignments.basis: The Library summary for this notice records drilling, casing, cementing, completion and hydrogeological tests for two wells. The 8 Nov 2026 rule draft proposes Drilling only and says the tag itself is not yet reviewed.
assignments.library_summary: Drilling, casing, cementing, completion and hydrogeological tests for two wells for a planned geothermal heating plant; GT-2 design option and right to drop GT-2.

provenance.ref: issues/issue-5-final.md, lines 26–33, as cited by the 8 Nov 2026 rule draft
provenance.note: That editorial file is not in this repository and was not opened here.

assignments.library_title: HVC: framework agreement for heat exchangers for geothermal projects

excluded.label: Project owners & developers
excluded.reason: The buyer being a project owner does not make the item a project-development or funding instrument. The stated scope is supply of heat exchangers.

assignments.basis: The Library summary identifies a framework for plate-and-frame heat exchangers for two plant locations. The 8 Nov 2026 rule draft proposes Equipment only and says the tag itself is not yet reviewed.
assignments.library_summary: Plate-and-frame heat exchangers for HVC's geothermal production plants; lots Westland (est. EUR 3.5m) and Slochteren (est. EUR 5m).

provenance.ref: issues/issue-5-final.md, lines 35–42, as cited by the 8 Nov 2026 rule draft

assignments.library_title: Energies du Grand Paris: project-management framework for the Paris heat networks (incl. geothermal production sites)

excluded.label: Drilling
excluded.reason: The Library summary is a maîtrise d'œuvre framework. It does not procure the drilling contracts. Future drilling is not a tag.

excluded.label: Equipment
excluded.reason: Substations and network length describe the system being designed and supervised. They are not a supply contract for equipment.

assignments.basis: The Library summary is a framework for maîtrise d'œuvre on the Paris heat networks. The 8 Nov 2026 rule draft proposes Engineering & Services only and says the tag itself is not yet reviewed.
assignments.library_summary: Framework for maîtrise d'œuvre; about 8 geothermal/renewable production sites, 200 km hot-water and 25 km steam network, 2,900 hot-water and 664 steam substations.
